notes: Phase 57: Three bugs in list_all_sources / gap detection identified during operator review on 2026-05-18. (1) last_ingested is always null — ingest scripts never call registry.update_source() + save(). (2) Gap table status column always shows 'missing' — GapDetector._get_actual_counts() may be using the wrong key name from the OpenSearch health_check response, so actual_counts resolves to {} and every collection appears uncovered. (3) doc_count in unified_manifest.json is static hand-entered data, never updated after ingestion. Fix plan: diagnose the indices_detail key mismatch first (Step 1), fix it (Step 2), add update_source_from_ingest convenience wrapper (Step 3), write + run a backfill script to populate last_ingested + doc_count from live OpenSearch (Step 4), update CHANGELOG (Step 5). No new unit tests required — existing update_source tests cover the registry; the backfill script is tested via dry-run + live list_all_sources verification.

followUps: After backfill, ingest scripts (ingest_documentation_v8.py and peers) should be updated to call update_source_from_ingest() on completion so last_ingested stays current going forward — tracked as a separate follow-up since the ingest scripts live in mcp_server_node/scripts/ and are not part of the Python port scope.

The backfill script sets last_ingested to the run timestamp, which is a lower bound — the actual ingest date is unknown for historical runs. This is acceptable for gap detection (stale threshold is 30 days) but should be noted in the CHANGELOG.
